title: Beach Blessing Vacation Rental
meta_description: Beach Blessing is a 4.00 bedroom, 4.00 bathroom vacation rental.
description_expanded: Description Experience modern coastal luxury and family-friendly comfort at Beach Blessing, a beautifully designed retreat in WaterColor’s Crossing District. With elegant interiors, generous living spaces, and a location just steps from the Dragonfly Pool, this pet-friendly home comfortably accommodates up to 11 guests. A 6-passenger electric cart, four adult bikes, and Beach Club access complete the perfect 30A experience.Property Highlights Exclusive Access to the WaterColor Beach Club and Community Pools with Up to 11 Passes Included 4 Adult Bikes Included in Rental 6-Passenger Street-Legal Electric Cart Included in Rental Pet Friendly (Additional Fee Applies) Parking for 2 Vehicles Natural Gas Grill Exterior Shower Just Steps to the Dragonfly Pool 4-Minute Bike Ride to Camp WaterColor 4-Minute Electric Cart Ride to Seaside 5-Minute Electric Cart Ride to WaterColor Beach Club Access Experience the Home Welcome to Beach Blessing, where every detail has been designed for style, comfort, and connection. This spacious two-story home combines open living areas, elegant décor, and thoughtfully curated furnishings that create a serene atmosphere for family gatherings or group getaways. The first floor features an open-concept living area with a large sectional sofa and flat-screen TV, ideal for relaxing after a day at the beach. The fully equipped kitchen includes stainless steel appliances, granite countertops, and a large island with seating for four. A dining area seating six and a nearby wet bar make this space perfect for entertaining. Also on this level is a half bath, laundry area, and the first king suite with a private bathroom featuring a walk-in shower. Upstairs, a bright secondary living room with a sectional sleeper sofa and flat-screen TV offers an inviting place for kids to play or guests to unwind. A built-in bunk area with twin-over-twin beds and an adjacent shared bath adds flexibility for families. The second-floor primary suite includes a king bed and private bathroom with a walk-in shower, while a king guest bedroom and queen guest bedroom share a Jack and Jill bathroom. Enjoy quiet mornings or breezy afternoons on the screened porch with peaceful neighborhood views. The fenced backyard and proximity to the Dragonfly Pool make this home as practical as it is beautiful. With a 6-passenger electric cart and four adult bikes included, guests can easily explore all of WaterColor and nearby Seaside. Beach Blessing offers everything you need for a luxury coastal getaway; elegant interiors, generous amenities, and a prime location for making unforgettable memories.Sleeping Arrangements First Floor: Primary Bedroom: King Bed (Sleeps 2), Private Bathroom with Walk-In Shower Half Bathroom Second Floor: Primary Bedroom: King Bed (Sleeps 2), Private Bathroom with Walk-In Shower Guest Bedroom: King Bed (Sleeps 2), Shared Bathroom with Walk-In Shower Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed (Sleeps 2), Shared Bathroom with Walk-In Shower Bunk Room: Twin-Over-Twin Bunk Bed (Sleeps 2), Shared Bathroom with Tub/Shower Combination Upstairs Living Area: Twin Sleeper Sofa (Sleeps 1), Shared Bathroom with Tub/Shower Combination Life in WaterColor Located in the Crossing District, Beach Blessing is just steps from the Dragonfly Pool and a short ride to Camp WaterColor and the Beach Club. With easy access to trails, Seaside, and the scenic beauty of 30A, this home offers a welcoming escape designed for relaxation, exploration, and family connection.
